intro.sr: Klijent sam pregleda i otkazuje svoj budući termin iz naloga, bez poziva ili poruke salonu: meni naloga, „Moji termini“, termin iz liste, „Otkaži termin“. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: A customer views and cancels their own upcoming appointment from their account, without calling or messaging the salon: account menu, “Moji termini”, the appointment from the list, “Otkaži termin”. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
